name: hunt_fv_oside15_ema_r15

source.title: Claude hunt 2026-10-20 (lens: fair value gaps with a second side): the owner's 15-minute open-side FVG (middle-candle stop) taken only when the 20-bar EMA of 15-minute closes agrees with the 09:30 open, at 1:1.5, two a day. Why it should pay: the open's side says who took control of the session, the EMA20 says the last five hours of price lean the same way; when both agree the newest gap on that side is unfilled trend buying (or selling) and the return to it is met by the trend's own orders. Who loses: the faders of a day whose open side and trend agree -- they sell the pullback into a gap that the trend defends, and their stops beyond the middle candle carry the move to 1.5R.

entry.words: On 15-minute candles from 09:30: above the 09:30 open AND above the 20-bar EMA of 15-minute closes, rest a buy limit at the near edge of the newest up fair value gap (at least 0.1 x ATR(14) tall); below the open AND below the EMA, a sell limit at the newest down gap. A newer gap or a flip of the side moves the order; no new order from 15:00. Stop at the middle candle's far end, target 1.5 x the stop. Up to 2 trades a day, one at a time. Flat 15:58.

not_run: PARTLY SEEN, SAID PLAINLY: this is the 15-minute open-side FVG family, whose unseen months (2025-07 on) were read three times (the 1-a-day sibling's walk-forward, the lane's no-cap walk-forward, the Desk walk-forward) and again in cl_fvg_oside_15_mid_r1_t2_gap0p1's walk-forward (which lost in the blind months). Its trades here are a subset of that sheet's entries with another target; the walk-forward of this sheet is NOT blind and must be read as partly seen.

THE GATE: the open layer's price_ema(20) on the 15-minute closes since 00:00 ET (seeded with the day's first close), read at the gap's close: (close - EMA20) / ATR(14) above 0 for a long, below 0 for a short. It is checked when the order is placed or moved.
THE SIDE vs the 09:30 open is read on each 15-minute close, not tick by tick.
THE STOP: the middle candle's far end (bar 2's low for an up gap, high for a down gap), floored at 0.25 x ATR(14) of the 15-minute bars and two ticks.
ONE INSTANCE 09:30-15:58: the cap of 2 is a DAY cap and one position at a time holds all day; after a trade only a gap formed after it counts; an unfilled order is cancelled at 15:00.
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage, $4 a round turn, tick replay, strict limit fills).
THE TEST DAYS (2025-07-01 on) ARE NOT READ by this sheet: build days only.
FLAT: every trade is flat by 15:58 ET (13:13 on half days).
